rules.title: Annual General Adjustment capped at 5% (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: The yearly Annual General Adjustment for fully covered units, set by the Rent Board using a CPI-based formula, cannot exceed 5% even if the formula produces a higher figure. Landlords with banked (unused) prior AGAs may still raise rent by more than 5% to reach the rent ceiling.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
rules.coverage_text: Fully covered units, including most units in multifamily properties built before 1980; new construction units with a certificate of occupancy issued after 1980 are only partially covered (no rent ceiling).
rules.exemptions: Partially covered units (new construction after 1980, most single-family homes and condominiums) have no rent ceiling. Banked AGAs may exceed 5% to reach the rent ceiling. Units where the tenant shares kitchen or bath with the landlord are exempt only if the landlord lived on the property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.interaction: The document does not discuss interaction with state rent-cap law.
rules.conflict_note: Text says fully covered multifamily units are those 'built before 1980' while new construction is 'certificate of occupancy issued after 1980'; the exact boundary year treatment is ambiguous.

rules.title: Government-owned or -subsidized units brought under Rent Ordinance coverage
rules.requirement: Government-owned or -subsidized units (e.g., Section 8, Shelter Plus Care, LIHTC) must be registered as fully or partially covered; fully covered ones have a rent ceiling limited by the Annual General Adjustment. Coverage level depends on unit type and whether federal or state law or regulation prohibits rent control.
rules.key_value: Subsidized units fully or partially covered depending on unit type
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: Whether a unit is fully or partially covered depends on unit type and if Federal law, State law, or administrative regulation exempts the unit from the rent control provisions of Berkeley’s Rent Ordinance.
rules.coverage_text: Government-owned or -subsidized rental units such as Housing Choice Voucher, Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC, HOME and others.
rules.exemptions: Section 202 and Section 811 units, and Rent Supplement, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside and Project-based Section 8 units in projects with HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgages, are only partially covered regardless of unit type.
rules.interaction: Federal law, state law or administrative regulation that prohibits rent control limits these units to partial coverage.

rules.title: Nonpayment eviction requires debt of at least one month's Fair Market Rent
rules.requirement: A landlord may evict for nonpayment of rent only if the tenant owes at least one month of HUD Fair Market Rent for an equivalent-size unit in the Oakland-Fremont metro area for the fiscal year the rent is demanded.
rules.key_value: Rental debt >= one month HUD FMR (Oakland-Fremont)
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Exempt units (e.g., shared kitchen/bath with a landlord who lived on the property at the start of the tenancy).

rules.title: No eviction for refusing to sign a substantially similar lease
rules.requirement: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease when a fixed-term lease expires; this just cause was eliminated.
rules.key_value: Refusal to sign new similar lease is not just cause
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.

rules.title: Stricter requirements for lease-breach evictions
rules.requirement: Eviction for violating a material lease term requires a mutually agreed term, substantial actual damage to the landlord, and unreasonable tenant behavior. The prior notice to cease must specify the lease term and describe the violation and harm in reasonable detail.
rules.key_value: Breach must cause substantial, actual damage; notice to cease must detail violation
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: The alleged violation must cause substantial, actual damage to the landlord.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.

rules.title: Eviction notice content and Rent Board filing within three business days
rules.requirement: Termination notices must state that advice is available from the Rent Board with its counseling phone number and website. Landlords must file copies of termination notices, notices to quit, and summons and complaints with the Rent Board within three business days of service.
rules.key_value: File with Rent Board within 3 business days of service
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: The landlord must file with the Rent Board a copy of any notice to terminate a tenancy, notice to quit, and summons and complaint no later than three business days after the tenant was served with the document.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.

rules.title: Mandatory annual inflation adjustment of owner move-in relocation payments
rules.requirement: The Rent Board must adjust owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts for inflation every year.
rules.key_value: Annual inflationary adjustment of OMI relocation assistance
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
rules.coverage_text: Owner move-in evictions of tenants in covered units.
